## Feature Description
A clear description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case
Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve? Describe what should happen in the Home app and in PagerDuty, rather than naming an API field.

## Proposed Solution
How do you think this could be implemented? See [docs/EVENTS-API.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-pagerduty/blob/main/docs/EVENTS-API.md) for what PagerDuty accepts, and [docs/FEATURES.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-pagerduty/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#out-of-scope) for what is out of scope.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions you've considered.

## Additional Context
Any other context, screenshots, or examples.
